title: PC-CROP Federal Accounting — integration event metadata-only exposure
purpose: Close a concrete security gap against sections 43, 48, 53 and invariant secret_leakage_to_logs=0: integration event logging currently accepts arbitrary request/response payloads and the staff read endpoint returns them. Replace default event persistence/exposure with bounded metadata and safe machine error codes without inventing a second audit/event store.
boundaries: Do not create a second IntegrationEvent/Audit/Outbox store; extend the existing IntegrationEvent path only.
Default persisted request/response event payloads become metadata summaries only, never original values.
Free-text thrown error messages are not persisted verbatim; only bounded machine-safe error codes may survive, otherwise a generic INTEGRATION_ERROR code is stored.
Staff list/get endpoints return metadata-only event projections and never requestPayload, responsePayload or raw errorMessage.
No universal admin exception exposes the redacted fields through this endpoint.
No Prisma schema/migration, apps/web, auth model, provider credential, banking, FGIS, hosting or production mutation.
Existing business execution must not depend on integration telemetry success; this slice does not turn telemetry storage into business authority.
Merge and green CI are not production acceptance.
requiredInvariants: A secret-looking value in request/response payload cannot appear in the persisted integration event payload field after this change.
A secret-looking value in Error.message cannot appear in the persisted event errorMessage after this change.
The staff event endpoint cannot return requestPayload, responsePayload or raw errorMessage.
Operational fields adapterName, direction, eventType, status, httpStatus, durationMs and createdAt remain available for fleet diagnostics.
Idempotency/external/deal identifiers may remain server-side but are not emitted by the metadata-only staff projection in this slice.
requiredChecks: existing security and integration event gates
